description: SR stream surface active. diSRStreamSurface Draw runs when the play state is active and updates the stream image frame; the SR video stream plays when the SR lane-line someIP channel (online_000C_000C) is online and the play state is granted. Here the lane-line someIP channel is online so SR stream content is rendered.
